verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only indirect support. WezTerm automatically reloads its config when the file changes, which is a built-in event-triggered action, and it exposes shell-integration user vars via __wezterm_set_user_var. Its configuration is Lua code that users describe as intuitive and programmable, but nothing in the pack shows users defining their own event→action rules. Missing for 10: documented user-definable event hooks/handlers (e.g. event callbacks in Lua config), a list of supported events (pane output, user-var changes, bell, etc.), examples of rules triggering actions, independent or hands-on corroboration of event-driven automation.
